crossRefs.note: I will cut off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.

translations.web: I will uproot your Asherah poles out from among you; and I will destroy your cities.
translations.bsb: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
translations.kjv: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
translations.asv: and I will pluck up thine Asherim out of the midst of thee; and I will destroy thy cities.
